sentences.text: This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No. 19/2012, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Subhash Place, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. Issue notice.
Learned APP appears on advance notice, and accepts notice.

3. The brief facts of the case are that the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 got married on 15.02.2009 according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and they lived together as husband and wife with each other.
Thereafter, the disputes and differences arose between them and they started living separately since 2011.

Accordingly, the petition under Section 13B(2) of the HMA was allowed and the marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was dissolved vide decree of divorce dated 10.09.2021 passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Courts, North-West, Rohini Delhi.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Courts, North-West, Rohini Delhi
entities.label: JUDGE

sentences.text: The copy of the decree is already on record.
5. Petitioners and respondent no.2 are present in Court and they have been identified by the IO.
I have interacted with the parties and they submit that they have settled their disputes.
Respondent No.2 admits that she has settled the matter amicably with the petitioners.
She further submits that the settlement/compromise has taken place voluntarily, without any force, pressure or coercion.
As per settlement, today, a demand draft of Rs. 1,00,000/- (bearing no. 010152 dated 13.10.2023 drawn on HDFC Bank) has been handed over to respondent no. 2.
Respondent No.2 submits that nothing remains to be adjudicated further between them and she has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
6. Learned APP for the State submits that in view of the settlement, the State has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 20:56:08 7.
Keeping in view the above facts and circumstances, since the matter has been amicably settled between the parties, no useful purpose will be served by keeping the case pending.
It will be nothing but abuse of the process of law.
Consequentially, this petition is allowed and FIR No. 19/2012, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Subhash Place and all proceedings emanating therefrom shall stand quashed.
8. The present petition stands disposed of accordingly.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J OCTOBER 16, 2023 p
